tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and scaffold background behind every screen. Never put body text on it without a surface when the text sits in a list or card.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, tab bar, navigation bar. The default ground for ink and ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, dialogs, menus, popovers. In dark it is lighter than surface so elevation reads without shadows.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Search fields, segmented control track, full slot chips, skeleton loaders. ink and ink-muted both read on it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines only: list dividers, card outlines, table rules. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders that define a control: text fields, secondary buttons, available slot chips, checkboxes. 3:1 on surface and bg in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, placeholders, inactive tab labels, on bg, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (4.5:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and past slot times only. Below 4.5:1 on purpose (WCAG exempts disabled controls); never for information someone needs to read.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Electric blue. The one call to action per screen, the selected slot, the selected day, active tab icon and label, links. 7:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of primary fills on web and desktop.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of primary fills (Android and desktop; iOS dims to 70% instead).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary, primary-hover and primary-pressed. Dark text in dark theme because primary lightens there.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tonal buttons, selected list rows, the attended badge, the free-facility tag. Pair with on-primary-soft.

tokens.name: on-primary-soft
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-soft (8:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: volt
tokens.usage: Volt lime, the bolt colour. A fill only: the few-places-left slot chip, the brand mark, the active-booking highlight, the dark-theme focus ring. Never text, a hairline or an icon on a light surface (1.2:1 on white).

tokens.name: on-volt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on volt, in both themes (13:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmed and paid states, positive KPI change, available-today counts. Text and icons on surface and success-soft; always with a word or icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success badges and banners. Text on it is success.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending payment, hold about to expire, verification under review, damage reports open. Text and icons on surface and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges and banners. Text on it is warning.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, cancelled bookings, destructive actions, negative KPI change. Text and icons on surface and danger-soft; always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error banners, field error states and cancelled badges. Text on it is danger.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a filled danger button.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard and switch-access focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset, on every interactive element (web, desktop, iPad keyboard, Android TV-style navigation).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: qr-ink
tokens.usage: QR modules on the booking ticket. Stays dark in dark theme: scanners need dark modules on a light ground.

tokens.name: qr-ground
tokens.usage: The QR quiet zone and ground, white in both themes. Raise screen brightness while the ticket QR is shown.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the confirmation headline, empty-state headline. KPI hero numbers use number-lg.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Root screen titles (the large title on iOS, the top app bar title on Android uses title).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Pushed screen titles, sheet and dialog titles, section headers.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Card titles, list row titles, the facility name.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels only. Chips, tabs and field labels use label: Alexandria is wide and crowds small controls.

styles.name: number-lg
styles.usage: KPI hero numbers in StatTile. Every number on screen is set in Cairo so the same digit never shows in two shapes.

styles.name: number
styles.usage: The date number in DayStrip and other standalone numbers next to headline-size text.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: الحجز متاح لمدة 7 أيام من النهارده.
styles.usage: Body copy, descriptions, row details. Arabic needs the 1.6 line height: never tighten it.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Prices, values in detail rows, emphasised words inside body.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Slot chip times, field labels, segmented control, tab labels on expanded layouts.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata, helper text under fields, timestamps.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Badges, bottom tab labels, chip sub-labels. The smallest size in the system: Arabic below 12px loses its dots.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Booking codes and receipt numbers, always set left-to-right inside an LTR isolate, even in Arabic text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its label, badge inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between slot chips, between a title and its caption.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Chip and badge horizontal padding, gap inside list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margin on compact, card padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sheet padding, gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Screen side margin on medium, gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Screen side margin on expanded and large, gap above a section header.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state and confirmation spacing.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large gaps on desktop dashboards.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top spacing of hero areas on large screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Slot chips, badges, text fields, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, images inside cards, segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the booking ticket, stat tiles. On iOS draw it as a continuous (squircle) corner.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets, large dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, the day strip selection, filter chips.

shadow.note: Light theme uses soft shadows; dark theme lifts with surface-raised instead, so its card shadow is none.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Facility cards and stat tiles that sit on bg.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the sticky booking summary bar.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs.

size.note: Fixed component sizes in logical pixels (Flutter dp / Figma px).

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, slot chips: the minimum touch target on every platform.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons in dense admin tables only, with a 48px hit area around them.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside badges and captions.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons, fields and list rows.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Navigation icons and standalone icon buttons.

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar on compact, before the bottom safe-area inset.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Navigation rail on medium.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Sidebar on expanded and large.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width on large screens; centre it beyond that.

breakpoint.note: Window width classes. Layout follows the window width, never the device name, so new foldables work without device code.

tokens.name: bp-medium
tokens.usage: From 600: unfolded foldables, small tablets, split-screen iPad. Navigation rail and list-detail.

tokens.name: bp-expanded
tokens.usage: From 840: iPad and tablets in landscape. Sidebar and list-detail.

tokens.name: bp-large
tokens.usage: From 1200: web and desktop. Sidebar, full admin tables, content capped at content-max.

motion.note: Motion inside screens and in Sprint components. Page transitions, sheets, dialogs and back gestures keep the platform's own timing (adaptive.md). Under reduced motion, durations collapse to a duration-fast fade or zero.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Press and hover, selecting a slot or a day, toggles, badge colour changes, exits. Also the reduced-motion fade.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: State changes inside a screen: AnimatedSwitcher between loading, content and empty; a slot turning full; expanding rows; the booking summary bar sliding in.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Larger custom moves: the facility image Hero into details, the booking ticket reveal.

tokens.name: duration-pulse
tokens.usage: One cycle of the skeleton loader's opacity pulse, repeating while loading. Static under reduced motion.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Anything that moves or changes while staying on screen.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Elements arriving: the booking summary bar, a new badge, the Hero landing, the ticket reveal.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Elements leaving. Pair with duration-fast so exits feel quicker than entries.
